item.title: Galveston ISD becomes latest district to reject daily prayer periods, Bible readings
item.description: GALVESTON – Galveston ISD on Wednesday became the latest local school district to reject school prayer periods, which are permitted by a new Texas law. Board members for Houston ISD, the largest district in Texas, also have voted against carving out prayer periods and Bible-reading sessions. item.title: Texarkana pastor arrested on five counts of rape
item.description: TEXARKANA — A pastor in Texarkana has been arrested in connection with an alleged rape case according to our news partners at KETK. Cedric Monteze Sharp, 51, was arrested on Wednesday, February 11, on five counts of rape, according to court documents.
